title: Future private single-account binding; NOT an activation file
$comment: No native proof is registered. Store only outside Git under private .arms-dev with owner-only ACL. Account/connection/label references must be domain-separated HMACs keyed per installation. An unkeyed digest does not hide a low-entropy account name. Hash canonical reviewed configuration; never treat self-reported hash as attestation. Revalidate one pinned object, provider, connection, configuration, label and freshness on each observation. Any change revokes; no auto-rebind.
